description:
Let's recreate Pokémon Bite Attack VFX in Unity! It's an inspired version, a fan made version, accompanied with a tutorial for anyone who wants to learn the magic of Visual Effects in Unity. We are going to use VFX Graph and Krita. Enjoy!

Check out the Indie Game Studio I founded: https://twitter.com/GoldenBugStudio


00:00 Intro 
00:46 VFX Graph - Bite Motion
04:46 Krita - Bite Texture
09:20 VFX Graph - Bite Size and Color
11:34 VFX Graph - Particles Impact 
15:50 VFX Graph - Flare
17:26 Krita - Flare Texture
18:40 End Result

-------------------------

POKEMON BITE PROJECT: https://www.patreon.com/posts/unity-vfx-graph-77053586
